contract_review_result.summary: Contract is close, but has reset/in_ready and latency semantics conflicts that can cause inconsistent implementations and verification expectations.

findings.issue: Spec says on rst_n=0 edge, in_ready=1 (since empty). Elsewhere, interface/module semantics state no transfer accepted on reset edge and in_ready high only when not in reset cycle, creating contradiction.
findings.requested_change: Make reset behavior consistent across artifacts: explicitly define in_ready during rst_n=0 cycles (recommended 0 to match module/interface text) and update reset.required_state accordingly.

findings.issue: Module manifest says in_ready high only when output register empty and not in reset cycle, conflicting with reset.required_state claiming in_ready=1 on reset cycle.
findings.requested_change: Align module manifest and reset sections to one rule for in_ready during reset; ensure same rule appears in interface/backpressure text.

findings.issue: Text says simultaneous dequeue/enqueue replacement in FULL is 'not used here because one-cycle no-stall requires EMPTY at accept'. This is ambiguous and can be read as architectural prohibition or merely guidance.
findings.requested_change: State explicit legality: either forbid simultaneous dequeue/enqueue in FULL, or permit it while preserving defined observable latency/ordering; remove ambiguous rationale sentence.
